subject: PoC mode finalizers — deployment playbook & commitments
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@medlytics.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: PoC mode finalizers — deployment playbook & commitments

Hi Carmen —

Great call this morning, thanks for walking through Medlytics' inference needs. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the PoC model and timeline: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Latency SLO: p95 < 220ms for single-turn generation on clinical note summarization.
- Throughput: sustained 120 qps during peak batch windows.
- Data autonomy: PHI will never leave Medlytics environment (must meet internal KMS controls).

Initial recommendation (based on the above)
- Private deployment (VPC) is the closest fit for PHI/KMS requirements.
- Alternate plan: Dedicated capacity in Redwood with customer-managed encryption keys if Medlytics can accept a short-term hosted tunnel for evaluation.

Proposed PoC scope and success criteria
- Duration: 4 weeks (2-week setup + 2-week load/quality run).
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 250ms; 95% of test prompts produce clinically acceptable output in the eval set (> 0.80 QA score); end-to-end roundtrip with customer KMS demonstrated in staging.
- Stakeholders: Carmen (product), Procurement (contract), Jonathan/CloudInfra (networking on VPC peering), Monica (Redwood SE lead).

Next actions I suggest
1) You confirm whether Medlytics requires a fully air-gapped on-prem install or if Private VPC with a peered subnet is acceptable (reply by EOD Thu 12/17).
2) If Private VPC: we'll schedule a technical kickoff with Monica + Jonathan for network prep (target week of 12/20).
3) If Dedicated: procurement and SLA redlines (I attached a draft) so we can move to a 30-day commitment for the PoC.

Attachments: Medlytics_PoC_Technical_Reqs.pdf, SLA-draft-Redwood-v1.docx

I'll hold workspace time for the kickoff once you confirm the deployment lane.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124

From: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@medlytics.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@medlytics.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC mode finalizers — deployment playbook & commitments

Sean —

Thanks for the thorough recap. A few clarifying points from our side before we lock the lane: 

1) Data residency/KMS: Our security team is adamant that production PHI must remain in our VPC. For PoC we can accept a peered Private VPC in our account (no public egress of model inputs). Is that supported?
2) Timeline: The week of 12/20 is tight for us — can we aim for the week of 1/3 instead? We have an internal freeze during the holidays.
3) Cost/commitment: Procurement wants to see a clear cap on spend for the PoC and an explicit rollback plan to avoid accidental scale charges.

Also — who will be our technical point-of-contact on the Redwood side for the network and KMS integration? We want an SE in the kickoff.

Carmen Ruiz
Director, Product — Medlytics
carmen.ruiz@medlytics.ai

On a separate note, can we loop Jonathan from CloudInfra (copied) to validate peering constraints?

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@medlytics.ai>, Jonathan Park <jonathan@cloudinfra.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@medlytics.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC mode finalizers — deployment playbook & commitments

Carmen — thanks, all good questions and reasonable asks. Quick replies: 

1) Private VPC peering: Yes — we support deploying our inference runtime into a customer VPC subnet (Redwood Private). That keeps data inside your account and lets you control KMS/HSM keys. Monica will lead technical details.
2) Timeline: Week of 1/3 works for Redwood. We'll target a Jan 4 kickoff.
3) Cost cap & rollback: For the PoC we can set a hard cap and we’ll instrument per-token and per-instance spend to prevent overruns; we’ll include this in the Statement of Work addendum.

Proposed immediate plan
- Jan 4: Technical kickoff (Monica + Jonathan + Medlytics infra + 1x Redwood infra PM).
- Jan 5–19: Network/KMS integration + model onboarding to staging.
- Jan 20–Feb 2: Load/quality run against your eval set.

Monica — can you confirm the network checklist items we should bring to the kickoff (routing, firewall rules, KMS policy snippets, expected peering CIDR ranges)? Also confirm if any special host-level probes are required for our runtime.

Carmen / Procurement — I'll send a short PoC addendum for signature after Monica and I align on kickoff scope.

Regards,
Sean

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Carmen Ruiz <carmen.ruiz@medlytics.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Jonathan Park <jonathan@cloudinfra.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procure@medlytics.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: PoC mode finalizers — deployment playbook & commitments

Hi team —

Thanks Sean. A few technical notes ahead of the Jan 4 kickoff so Medlytics can prepare: 

Network & security checklist (short)
- RFC1918 CIDR requested for peering: please provide three /24 candidates (we'll pick one).
- Allowlist: outbound to our runtime management endpoints (tcp 443) from the peered subnet; we'll provide exact FQDNs next week.
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys (Cloud KMS or AWS KMS/HSM). We need a key ARN and a service principal to grant decrypt/encrypt on the key for the Redwood runtime role.
- Storage: model artifacts will be staged on an S3 bucket in your account with tight IAM policies — provide bucket name and an admin IAM user for initial sync.

PoC operational constraints
- We recommend a staging instance size of 2x A10G or equivalent for the load profile you described (120 qps sustained with batching).
- We'll enable prefix caching and a conservative batching window to balance p95 latency. Expect p95 to be ~180–260ms depending on prompt distribution — we'll tune during the first week.

Attachments included: Medlytics_PoC_Technical_Reqs.pdf (detailed checklist)

I'll follow up next week with the exact FQDNs and a short runbook for the kickoff. If Jan 4 still stands for everyone, I'll send a calendar invite with pre-read.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
